title: A replaced CI attempt finishes late
when: A foreground command-ci case finishes after another attempt supersedes its run.
need: Only an error run marked with replacement_ci_run_id and a newer run for the same requirement ignores late completion and artifact addition. The original run and evidence stay unchanged. The case command reports the ignored verdict and exits zero; it does not credit that verdict to the replacement. Other settled runs retain immutable verdicts.
surface: qa case run completion output and run recording handlers
review: Source regression coverage; deployed race behavior is not live proof.
